name: Custom Shape Wooden Swaying Car Ornament
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from premium 3mm natural wood, offering a lightweight yet durable construction for long-lasting use.
    - Features multiple precision-cut wooden pieces connected by a smooth rotating mechanism, creating an interactive swaying effect.
    - Includes a sturdy metal bead chain for easy hanging on rearview mirrors, Christmas trees, bags, or anywhere you'd like to display it.
    - Smoothly finished edges with high-quality craftsmanship for a polished and premium appearance.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in 2 sizes:
           +) 2 inches (Maximum assembled size: 2 x 2 inches ~ 5.08 x 5.08 cm)
           +) 3 inches (Maximum assembled size: 3 x 3 inches ~ 7.62 x 7.62 cm)
    - Additional Details:
           +) Total assembled thickness: approximately 1.7 cm.
           +) Hanging chain length: 11.8 inches ~ 29.97 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Finished with UV printing for sharp detail, vibrant color, and a long-lasting decorative surface.
    - Front layer features 1-sided printing.
    - Rotating pieces feature 2-sided printing for a complete appearance from multiple viewing angles.
     
  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a fun interactive hanging ornament featuring a unique rotating and swaying mechanism.
    - Easily hangs from car rearview mirrors, Christmas trees, backpacks, handbags, office spaces, windows, or home décor displays.
    - The movable pieces gently sway while driving or with natural movement, creating a playful and eye-catching effect.
    - Perfect for personalizing vehicles, decorating seasonal displays, or showcasing favorite characters, pets, family members, or custom artwork.
    - Lightweight construction makes it easy to hang securely without adding unnecessary weight.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful personalized gift for family members, friends, couples, pet lovers, coworkers, or anyone who enjoys unique keepsakes.
    - Perfect for Christmas, Halloween, Valentine's Day, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Birthdays, Anniversaries, Graduations, Housewarmings, and other special celebrations.
    - An excellent custom gift for new drivers, car enthusiasts, pet owners, and loved ones who enjoy personalized accessories.
    - A memorable keepsake that combines decorative charm with interactive movement, making every gift feel more meaningful and unique.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape Wooden Swaying Car Ornament

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
